description: Limits each user's local SQLite database while preserving core conversation context. Under pressure it evicts old tool outputs first, reclaims rebuildable memory indexes, then removes session families from binned to normal to pinned.
note: Tool and memory percentages are preferred shares of the total limit. Unused space may be borrowed until the database is under pressure. Running sessions and the family just moved to the bin are protected.

settings.label: Maximum database size (MB)
settings.hint: Default: 100 MB per user. Cleanup preserves messages by reclaiming tool payloads and rebuildable memory data before deleting sessions.

settings.label: Tool output share (%)
settings.hint: Preferred share for tool requests and stored results. Old results are replaced by a replay-safe storage notice when cleanup runs.

settings.label: Agent memory share (%)
settings.hint: Preferred share for memory pages and vector indexes. Rebuildable chunks are reclaimed before memory pages; conversation storage receives the remaining percentage.
